source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 4 同主题完形(藏身偷渡的男孩/冰上的厨子/勇气的小贴士/坚持的运动员/沙漠迷路/一封鼓励信)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一、四选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞。答案位随后打散。

passages.title: The Boy Who Hid Aboard
passages.text: Perce Blackborow was a young man who longed for (1)____. When he heard that a great expedition to the Antarctic needed brave men, he was so (2)____ that he asked to join at once. Sadly, his application was turned (3)____, because the leaders thought he was too young and not (4)____ enough. But Perce would not give up. With a friend's help, he secretly got (5)____ the ship and hid in a dark (6)____ until they were far out at sea. When he was finally (7)____, the captain was angry, yet he could not help admiring the boy's courage. Instead of sending him away, he (8)____ Perce the job of cooking for the (9)____. From that day on, Perce worked hard and never complained, proving that his (10)____ to join had been right all along.

passages.title: The Cook on the Ice
passages.text: Life on the ice was hard, and feeding the men was the (1)____ of the young cook. There were no shops and no fresh food, only the (2)____ of the sea animals the crew managed to catch. Day after day he (3)____ the same meat in different ways, trying to make it taste better. To make fire, he burned animal fat, which gave (4)____ thick, oily smoke that hurt everyone's eyes. The work was (5)____ and dirty, but he never lost his good (6)____. He knew that a warm meal could lift the (7)____ of the whole group on a freezing night. Whenever someone felt low, the cook would offer a hot drink and a kind (8)____. His care helped the men stay (9)____ through the long, dark months. Years later, he remembered this difficult time as one of the proudest (10)____ of his whole life.

passages.title: A Few Words on Courage
passages.text: Many people think that courage means feeling no (1)____ at all. In fact, brave people are often afraid, but they act in (2)____ of their fear. The first (3)____ of courage is simply to take one small step forward. When a problem feels too (4)____, do not look at the whole mountain; look only at the next stone under your foot. Another secret is to (5)____ on, even when progress is slow. Those who keep going through (6)____ usually win in the end. It also (7)____ to share your fears with someone you trust, because a problem (8)____ is a problem made smaller. Finally, remember to help the people around you. In hard times, those who think only of (9)____ rarely do well, while those who support others find new (10)____ they did not know they had.

passages.title: The Runner Who Would Not Quit
passages.text: At the start of the long race, no one paid much (1)____ to John, a quiet runner near the back. Halfway through, he fell badly and hurt his (2)____. The pain was sharp, and many told him to (3)____ up and rest. But John shook his head and slowly got back on his (4)____. He had been (5)____ for this race for a whole year, and he would not waste all that effort. Step by painful step, he kept (6)____ forward, far behind the others. The crowd grew quiet, then began to (7)____ his name. When at last he crossed the finish line, he was the (8)____ runner of all, yet he received the loudest (9)____ of the day. John later said that the medal did not matter; what mattered was that he had not let his (10)____ defeat him.

passages.title: Lost in the Desert
passages.text: Maria had been hiking in the desert for hours when she realised she was (1)____. The sun was (2)____ behind the hills, and her water was almost gone. Fear rose in her chest, but she forced herself to stay (3)____. Panic, she knew, would only make things (4)____. First, she stopped and (5)____ about her situation carefully. Then she remembered a piece of (6)____ her father had once given her: in trouble, stay where you are and make yourself easy to (7)____. So she built a small fire that gave (8)____ a tall line of smoke. All night she fed the (9)____, keeping it burning in the cold wind. At dawn, a rescue plane saw the smoke and circled overhead. Maria waved with all her (10)____, and within an hour she was safe. Her calm thinking had saved her life.

passages.title: A Letter to a Friend
passages.text: Dear Tom, I heard that you have been (1)____ a hard time at school lately, and I want you to know that you are not (2)____. Everyone meets (3)____ sooner or later; what matters is how we face it. Please do not (4)____ up on the things you love. When I failed my first exams, I felt (5)____ too, but my sister gave me good (6)____: take one small step each day. Little by (7)____, things got easier. Try to find one person you can (8)____, and share how you feel; a worry shared is much lighter. Remember that this difficult time is only an (9)____ in your long life, not the whole story. I truly believe you have the (10)____ to get through it. Stay strong, and write back soon. Your friend, Anna.
